summary: MG-VMS v0.5.1.a Welcome Center — full backend + frontend testing. All 13 pytest tests pass (8 Welcome Center HTTP live + 5 TESTING bypass unit). All Welcome Center UI features confirmed against admin login: greeting, 9 health components, health ring, version card v0.4.3-stable with changelog button, 4 stats, 8 Centers links, alerts, tips, news admin CRUD, prefs with persistence after reload, sidebar entries 'Accueil' + 'Tableau de bord', /dashboard route still accessible. Sequential admin login (15x) via public URL returned all 200 → no 423/429 (brute-force lockout not triggered for valid credentials, as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.py health.score depends on live go2rtc + plugins state; on this pod score sits at 76/100 (expected 70-80) — matches spec.
Score ring color thresholds are 60/85 (warn/ok) — coherent with alerts rules.
welcome_news created_by uses email only — no user id stored, minor limitation if user email is renamed (non-blocking).

PrefsInput exclude_none semantics: passing last_seen_version=null is filtered out (uses exclude_none) — so 'reset last_seen_version' via null does not persist. The tests use it for cleanup but rely on default fallback; consider explicit reset endpoint. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test news 'TEST_news_iter40' created + auto-deleted during flow. Prefs hide_until_next_version toggled + reset. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py now inserts /app/backend into sys.path so unit tests importing 'auth'/'security' modules work from any pytest rootdir. TESTING=1 is forced automatically. Backend service (supervisor) does NOT have TESTING=1 (this is by design — bypass is pytest-only via conftest.py). All Welcome Center endpoints/UI are stable.
rca of the issue: Initial run of test_testing_bypass.py failed 4/5 with ModuleNotFoundError('security'/'auth') because pytest.ini rootdir is /app/backend but pytest was invoked from /app; sys.path didn't include /app/backend for the tests directory. Fix: added sys.path.insert to conftest.py at the top so backend modules are always importable during test collection. After fix all 13 tests pass in ~3s.
